newsitem.title: NIGERIA: West African natgas project to get company - Nigeria.
newsitem.headline: West African natgas project to get company - Nigeria.

text.p: The steering committee of a project to pipe Nigerian gas to three West African countries decided to set up a company for this project, Nigerian oil minister Dan Etete said Tuesday.
"The company will take full responsibility for the running of the project," Etete told reporters at Lagos airport on his return from a meeting of the committee in Accra, Ghana.
Chevron Corp is known to be bidding to build the pipeline to carry Nigerian natgas to Benin, Togo and Ghana.

Etete, chairman of the steering committee, whose Accra meeting on Monday was attended by the oil ministers of the three other countries said oil companies and individuals would be allowed to participate in the project.
He said the project company would take off within the next four weeks, adding that the four nations were determined that the execution of the project should begin by January 1997.
An agreement to implement the project was signed in July.
The pipeline would carry gas from Chevron's Escravos field which is currently being flared.
According to a World Bank study, West African nations would benefit from cheap and plentiful Nigerian gas if the project estimated at about $260 million succeeds.
